Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome versions {#versions}

List, publish, unpublish, freeze, fork, compare and delete versions.

```text
apiome versions [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`compatibility`](#versions-compatibility), [`delete`](#versions-delete), [`fork`](#versions-fork), [`freeze`](#versions-freeze), [`get`](#versions-get), [`list`](#versions-list), [`publish`](#versions-publish), [`unpublish`](#versions-unpublish).

## apiome versions compatibility {#versions-compatibility}

Check two versions for breaking changes — a CI gate (POST /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project}/compatibility).

Exit codes: 0 no unsuppressed breaking change, 6 at least one, 8 the server could not be reached or failed fetching either side, 2 a bad argument or reference.

```text
apiome versions compatibility [OPTIONS] PROJECT
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--base` | text |  |  | Older version: label (2.0.0 or v2.0.0), revision UUID or tag. Default: the most recent published version before --head. |
| `--head` | text |  |  | Newer version: label, revision UUID or tag. Default: the latest version. |
| `--severity` | text | `info` |  | Show findings at this level or above: error, warn or info (default). |
| `--allow-removals` | flag |  |  | Treat breaking removals as warnings, so they do not fail the gate. |
| `--ignore` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Rule id to skip, e.g. path_removed (repeat, or comma-separate). removed-path spelling is accepted. |
| `--sarif` | flag |  |  | Print SARIF 2.1.0 (for GitHub code scanning) instead of the table. |

## apiome versions delete {#versions-delete}

Delete a version, after typing it to confirm (DELETE /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project}/{version_record_id}).

Meant for drafts. A published or frozen version is refused unless --force, which unpublishes (with --reason) and unfreezes it first. Version tags pointing at it stop the delete unless --detach-tags or --force removes them.

```text
apiome versions delete [OPTIONS] PROJECT VERSION
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `VERSION_REF` | text | yes | Version label (2.2.0 or v2.2.0), revision UUID or version tag. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--detach-tags` | flag |  |  | Remove the version tags pointing at it first. |
| `--force` | flag |  |  | Delete a published or frozen version: unpublish and unfreeze it first, and remove its tags. |
| `--reason` | text |  |  | Unpublish reason, required with --force on a published version. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the typed confirmation. |

## apiome versions fork {#versions-fork}

Fork a version into another project, keeping its lineage (POST /v1/versions/{tenant}/{target}/fork).

Copies the source version's classes and their properties into a new draft version of the target project, recorded as a fork so it can merge back later. Paths are not copied. Within one project, use a branch instead: the server refuses a same-project fork.

```text
apiome versions fork [OPTIONS] PROJECT_REF SOURCE_REF
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Source project slug or UUID. |
| `SOURCE_REF` | text | yes | Source version: label (2.1.0 or v2.1.0), revision UUID, or version tag. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--into` | text |  | yes | Target project (slug or UUID) the fork is created in. |
| `--to` | text |  | yes | New version label in the target, e.g. 3.0.0. |
| `--notes` | text |  |  | Short revision note. |
| `--notes-file` | path |  |  | Markdown file used as the new version's changelog. |
| `--include-tags` | flag |  |  | Also create the source's version tags on the fork. |
| `--allow-lesser` | flag |  |  | Allow --to to be lower than or equal to the source. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Show what would be copied without forking. |

## apiome versions freeze {#versions-freeze}

Freeze a published version's OpenAPI document byte-for-byte (POST …/{version_record_id}/freeze-schema).

Shows the snapshot's class, property and path counts, SHA-256 and size, then asks before freezing. While frozen, /v1/schema/{tenant}/{project}/{version} serves exactly those bytes, whatever later happens to the version's classes. --unfreeze removes the snapshot.

```text
apiome versions freeze [OPTIONS] PROJECT VERSION
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `VERSION_REF` | text | yes | Published version label (2.1.0 or v2.1.0) or revision UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--unfreeze` | flag |  |  | Remove the snapshot; refused once it has been downloaded. |
| `--force-unfreeze` | flag |  |  | Unfreeze even though the snapshot has been downloaded (tenant administrators only). |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the confirmation. |

## apiome versions publish {#versions-publish}

Publish a version (POST …/{version_record_id}/publish).

```text

```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VERSION` | text | yes | Version UUID, or a slug/label when --project is supplied. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project UUID or slug. |
| `--visibility`, `-v` | text | `public` |  | Publish visibility: 'public' (catalog) or 'private' (tenant-protected). |

## apiome versions unpublish {#versions-unpublish}

Unpublish a version: return it to draft and move its tags back (POST …/{version_record_id}/unpublish).

Shows what will happen — the spec endpoints it disappears from, the version tags that move to the next-most-recent published version, the webhook subscribers notified — then asks you to type the version to confirm. The reason is stored and shown by `versions get`.

```text
apiome versions unpublish [OPTIONS] PROJECT [VERSION]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FIRST` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID (or the version, when --project is passed). |
| `SECOND` | text |  | Version label (2.1.0 or v2.1.0) or revision UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  |  | Project UUID or slug; the older form `unpublish <version> --project <project>`. |
| `--reason` | text |  |  | Why it is unpublished; recorded for audit. Required unless --silent. |
| `--keep-tags` | flag |  |  | Leave version tags on it instead of moving them to the previous published version. |
| `--silent` | flag |  |  | Do not notify webhook subscribers (tenant administrators only). |
| `--force` | flag |  |  | Unpublish even when it is the project's only published version. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the typed confirmation. |
